text:
tara: Heads up — customer reported a bunch of 403s on SSE resume after we rotated auth tokens last night. Looks like resume tries to use the old bearer and gets rejected. Anyone seen this in staging?

iqbal: saw a spike in resume failures on staging at 03:12 UTC. It was a 401->resume->401 loop. Traced it to resume handler checking only Authorization header, not the session cookie.

dana: can repro with curl: initial stream creates session, then rotate token, client calls /resume with Resume-Session cookie + old Authorization header and server responds 403.

maria: console shows 'resumed' vs 'reconnected' counts but no breakdown for auth failures. Operators can't tell if it's resume auth or route-mismatch. We need a resume_auth_failure metric.

ops-bot: deploy v3.8.7 (canary) finished at 2026-03-19T03:05:22Z

iqbal: idea: during token rotation we emit a short-lived resumption token from control-plane that is accepted by resume endpoints. Safer than accepting arbitrary old bearer. But requires control-plane change + runtime to validate signed cookie.

tara: security concern — we should not broaden resume acceptance without signing. Accepting either cookie OR bearer widens attack surface.

maria: telemetry plan: add meter resume_auth_failure{reason="token_mismatch|no_token|expired"} and increment on resume auth rejects. Console tile to show trends and top tenants. I'll own this.

dana: runtime fix (WIP): make resume handler accept a control-plane-signed cookie named Resume-Token OR the current bearer. If bearer is stale, check cookie. Also ensure we rehydrate kv-cache when session lands on different node. PR: https://git/repo/pull/456 (WIP)

iqbal: tests needed: token rotation + sticky routing + resume hitting node-without-kv -> ensure fallback rehydrate path triggers and doesn't double-charge client. Also add unit tests for signed cookie verification and replay protection.

tara: UX/Console: show "resume_failed_auth" with quick link to session tracer and sample logs. Right now operators dig through raw logs. Maria, can you add a small alert rule (SLO) for >5 resume_auth_failures/5m for enterprise tenants?

maria: yep. I'll add the alert and the pivot in the tile. Will include an example log snippet and link to the trace ID.

dana: logs excerpt we saw:
```
[2026-03-19T12:34:56Z] auth.go:98 reject resume session=abc123 tenant=t42 reason=token_mismatch
[2026-03-19T12:34:56Z] auth.go:99 details="auth header expired, resume-cookie present"
```
(note: will redact tokens before shipping)

iqbal: followups: 1) add resume_auth_failure metric; 2) implement signed resume token in control-plane; 3) patch runtime to accept signed token OR current bearer with strict validation; 4) console rollout showing failures and per-tenant traces; 5) safe retry: if resume fails auth, attempt a full reconnect once with rehydrate to avoid silent 401 loop.

tara: timeline? support needs a customer-facing workaround ASAP. If we can patch runtime in 24h and enable console alerts, that's sufficient for a temporary mitigation.

dana: I'll spike the runtime patch now and aim to have a canary by EOD. Putting WIP PR up: https://git/repo/pull/456 (WIP).

iqbal: I'll design the signed resume token format and review Dana's PR. Keep it short-lived (<=60s) and include tenant id + session id + nonce. Crypto: HMAC with control-plane key, rotate keys regularly.

maria: I'll add the metric + console tile, and wire an alert to #oncall. Also add a link in the tile to the support workaround doc.

tara: assign owners: telemetry/console = maria, runtime = dana, auth design = iqbal, customer comms = tara. I'll coordinate the post.

ops-bot: reminder: please add changelog entry for resume auth behavior in release notes.

tara: thanks — please keep updates here. Once we merge the patch I'll ping support to tell affected customers. :thumbsup:
